groups.proposed_text: Senior Associate — Client Implementation | BNY Mellon — Pune, India  Oct 2024 – Jan 2026

Delivered end-to-end Client Implementation and Client Onboarding services for institutional clients, coordinating across Front, Middle, and Back Office to ensure seamless account setup and service delivery. Managed Wealth and Portfolio Management services including assets management, account opening, and end-to-end portfolio  servicing to support accurate reporting and client satisfaction. Supported Global Treasury Operations and Capital Markets functions spanning cash management, liquidity, payments, and  reconciliations for institutional clients across multiple regions. Drove Liquidity Management, Liquidity Structuring, and Treasury Solutions initiatives aligned with client and regulatory requirements across cross-border treasury operations. Led Client Migration and Client Onboarding projects as central point of coordination across Front, Middle, and Back Office  stakeholders, delivering a lockbox setup project with zero disruption. Processed and validated real-time and cross-border payment transactions across both international and domestic payment  processing channels (WIRE, ACH, NACHA), performing bank reconciliation to ensure accuracy and compliance. Provided business support on client-facing projects, gathering requirements and coordinating with stakeholders through delivery  to align solutions with payment processing needs. Supported UAT testing for platform migrations and system enhancements, logging and tracking items via JIRA to ensure quality  delivery. Authored BRD and FRD documentation, translating business requirements into functional specifications to guide platform  migrations. Directed Hedge Fund Accounting NAV calculations, net asset valuations, and banking operations activities including clearing,  settlement, cash, and position reconciliation across Equity, Fixed Income, Derivatives, and FX asset classes.

Senior Analyst — Hedge Fund Services, Middle Office Operations | Northern Trust — Pune, India  Sep 2021 – Oct 2024 Delivered end-to-end Trade Support across the complete Trade Life Cycle — booking, affirmation, confirmation, clearing, and settlement — for listed and OTC products. Managed Trade Capture, Confirmation, Fails Management, and Break Resolution for listed products, ensuring timely  T+0/T+1/T+2 trade validation with Prime Brokers and custodians. Handled trade booking, amendments, pricing updates, and allocations via Omega CTM and Oasys, supporting mark-to-market  (MTM) processing across the trade life cycle.

Provided trade operation support and clearing & settlement services across Equity, Fixed Income, Derivatives, and Trade  Finance instruments, maintaining clean books and records. Owned resolution of cash and position breaks and aged-item escalations, acting as key liaison across Front Office, Middle Office,  and Prime Brokers. Directed derivative and cash balance management, fund accounting, and fixed income processing while identifying team-level  risks and implementing process controls that stabilized operations. Trained new hires on trade capture, confirmation, and break-resolution workflows, accelerating ramp-up to independent case  handling.
Senior Analyst — Middle Office Operations | State Street — Pune, India  Aug 2019 – Aug 2021

Executed end-to-end Reconciliation across Cash and Position, Bank Reconciliation, Nostro, and OTC products for hedge fund clients, performing daily reconciliations with custodians. Managed the full trade life cycle including confirmation, settlement, and reconciliation across Derivatives, Fixed Income, and  Capital Markets instruments, alongside hedge fund accounting responsibilities. Used TLM for cash balance matching and OTC derivatives reconciliation, contributing to process migration projects supporting  end-to-end global client services. Built strong working knowledge of Capital Markets, Equity, Bonds, and Derivatives, applying this understanding to daily  reconciliation and settlement activities.
